## Summary

Child work item audit for Tests + documentation (CG-0MTDEEUWI0079IOV). 

All 3 ACs are MET. Comprehensive test suite exists covering data model, coin-grid packing, phased animation, turn controller integration, and SFX wiring. Documentation updated in `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md` with full phased income animation section including trigger, phases, SFX, reduced motion, replay exemption, and reuse guidance. Code comments document public APIs (`animateIncomePhases`, `createCoinGrid`, `IncomeResult.phaseBreakdown`).

## Acceptance Criteria Status

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | Unit tests: per-phase breakdown accuracy (multiple slots, synergy, rep, active effects, combined) + coin-grid packing for 1–20+ coins (5×3, 10×3, 15×3). | Met | `income-phase-data.test.ts`: 15 unit tests covering breakdown accuracy. `coin-grid.test.ts`: 16 unit tests for packing algorithm across all thresholds. |
| 2 | Browser tests: phase ordering, grid packing stress test (15+ coins), event/upcoming fly-in/out, reduced-motion path, integration (animation on end-turn, SFX, HUD total). | Met | `income-phase-animation.browser.test.ts`: 6 browser tests — phase ordering, grid rendering, event lines, reduced motion, non-blocking, replay exemption. `coin-grid.browser.test.ts`: 6 browser tests including 20-coin small card stress test. `income-collection-animator.test.ts`: unit tests for integration path. |
| 3 | Documentation: `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md` updated with phased income animation docs; scene README updated; code comments for public APIs. | Met | `docs/main-street/ux-visual-audio.md:46-95`: comprehensive phased income section (12 paragraphs). `animateIncomePhases()` (line ~393): 60+ line JSDoc. `createCoinGrid()` (line ~278): 20+ line JSDoc. `packCoins()` (line ~145): 30+ line JSDoc. |
